publication issues.summary: Partial unapproved V4: 24 unresolved render cells including 21 wire glyph differences and nine uncertainties: six illegible pin identities and assumed one-character first-destination branch lengths for AD4, AB4 and BB4. Team3 reports 137 unresolved endpoint claims, 48 unlabeled contacts and six control-only records; preserve literal J07-star-T ordering and asymmetric targets. Parent viewed native tile 1-4 only, including BX B03-star and AB J07-star-T; no full-route conclusion. Block and independent edge fits disagree by up to 30.757 px. Other 15 native tiles, 26 junctions, 239 crossings, full routes, omissions and warp remain unassessed. Twenty-five generated sections were not inspected; 11 zero-length segments and 239 unjoined entries are leads only. External schema status remains unestablished.
